author: William Saville
content:
Distrusting and trying,
To go through life,
Sliced and torn,
By its serrated knife.
Breathe in and out,
Panic attacks and fear,
Hair stands on end,
Vision far from clear.
Strike me down,
As I already cower,
Throw me aside,
Rip me like a flower.
I am not delicate,
Though I cry with ease,
I am a survivor,
Though I do too much to please.
I’d walk through fire,
For those with a place in my heart,
Get up from my wheelchair,
And with pain I depart.
But I’d brave every flame,
Every blister and burn,
For those I love,
When will I ever learn?
I give too freely,
My heart and my time,
My words of praise and hope,
Sound rich and sublime.
But when will I learn,
To walk through flame for myself,
To love myself deeply,
To give myself words of wealth?
I say I love me,
Every scar and pain,
But when people bring me down,
I’m the first one I blame…..
